@graph.howPerformed: Your session begins with a consultation and skin analysis, followed by numbing cream for comfort. The MNRF device then delivers controlled RF energy through the microneedles, and a soothing cream is applied afterwards. Before treatment, avoid sun exposure or tanning for 48 hours, and stop retinol or exfoliating products a week before.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most people tolerate it well. Numbing cream is applied before the treatment to keep discomfort to a minimum.

mainEntity.name: How long does the procedure take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It typically takes around 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the size of the treatment area.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients need 3–5 sessions, spaced 4–6 weeks apart, for optimal results.
Downtime is minimal. Mild redness or swelling subsides within a day or two. Use sunscreen daily, and avoid hot showers, saunas and strenuous exercise for 24–48 hours.
